test_Configuration_equality: test that two habitat_sim Configuration objects with identical SimulatorConfiguration and AgentConfiguration are equal
test_Configuration_set_get: test setting and getting string, bool, integer, float, and vector values on a Configuration object
test_Configuration_subconfig: test creating nested subconfigs, setting values in them, and navigating the subconfig hierarchy
test_Configuration_find_value_location: test finding the breadcrumb path to a value stored deep in a nested subconfig tree
test_ObjectAttributes_physics: test setting and getting physics properties like mass, inertia, friction, and damping on an ObjectAttributes template
